config.activeHint: Guests will be able to contribute by card
config.commit1: The money goes straight to your Stripe account: BirthReminder never holds it and never touches the funds. You remain solely responsible for the money pool towards contributors.
config.commit2: Good to know: if you refund a contribution, the fees taken on the original payment are not returned to you by Stripe.
config.directHint: Offer your IBAN and/or your PayPal link: guests send you the money directly, without turning on a money pool.
config.ibanNote: 🔒 The IBAN is encrypted and deleted automatically after this period.
config.externalNote: The collection happens entirely on the chosen service. BirthReminder sees neither the amounts nor the participants, cannot confirm anything in a dispute and cannot refund anything: your guests will have to contact you, or that service.

mine.title: My contributions
mine.empty: You have not contributed to any money pool yet. Your contributions will show up here, with their receipt.
mine.note1c: of each event. BirthReminder never holds the funds and therefore cannot refund on their behalf.
mine.note2: If an event is cancelled or the gift is not bought, contact the host: the "copy" button prepares a ready-made message with the amount, date and reference. If they do not reply, write to us and attach that summary. We cannot settle a disagreement, but the reference lets us find the payment and confirm it did take place.
